adjudication.rationale: The diff shows only one test-shaped file touched (apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts) and its only assertion change is destinationCalendar: null → [] in a webhook payload. Meanwhile, substantial new/changed logic is introduced outside tests—e.g., EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents now loops over destinationCalendar[] and fetches missing credentials via prisma.credential.findUnique; updateBooking and handleCancelBooking switch from single calendar reference to processing arrays of references; handleNewBooking collects teamDestinationCalendars and mutates evt.destinationCalendar; CalendarManager.createEvent changes the Calendar.createEvent signature and passes credential.id. None of these paths are referenced by any test changes in the diff, so the concern about untested new behavior is specific and diff-grounded (even though the claim about CI being green is speculative).
